title: Rana Concat Limited v. U.P. Power Corporation Ltd.
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Tarun Agarwala, J.; Abhai Kumar, J.
disposition: Writ dismissed for want of instructions.
headnote: Where counsel for the writ petitioner states that he has no instructions, the High Court dismisses the petition without considering the supply dispute against the distribution licensee.
facts: Rana Concat Limited filed Writ-C No. 57596 of 2006 in the Allahabad High Court against U.P. Power Corporation Ltd. and others. The petition was listed on 9 February 2017 before a Division Bench of Tarun Agarwala and Abhai Kumar, JJ. Counsel for the petitioner then stated that he had no instructions. The record discloses no hearing on the connection, billing, or other supply grievance, and the Court did not examine any provision of the Electricity Act or the Supply Code.

holding_units.holding: The writ petition is dismissed because learned counsel for the petitioner has no instructions in the matter.
